question: Under Rail Kaushal Vikas Yojana, launched in September 2021, how many candidates will be provided training in four trades viz Electrician, Welder, Machinist and Fitter, over a period of three years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**50,000.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Under Rail Kaushal Vikas Yojana, launched in September 2021, **50,000 candidates** will be provided training in four trades viz Electrician, Welder, Machinist and Fitter, over a period of three years.
